quizData.question: What is the main challenge when testing composables that use lifecycle hooks like `onMounted`?

options.text: They cannot be tested at all
They need to be used inside a mounted component
They require mocking the entire Vue runtime
They must be tested with E2E tests

quizData.explanation: Lifecycle hooks are only called when a component is mounted, so you need to mount a component that uses the composable.
